Command `python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
urls=[
 'https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=10129&can=1&sort=-id',
 'https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/csv?can=1&q=id:10129',
 'https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/json?can=1&q=id:10129',
 'https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=10129&format=json',
]
for url in urls:
 print('\nURL',url)
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
  data=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10).read(10000)
  print(data.decode('utf-8','ignore')[:5000])
 except Exception as e: print('ERR',repr(e))
